title: Git status submodules: follow-ups from the 2A84 R2 review (wrong-type tree OIDs, accessible rename, subprocess fan-out, fixture robustness, test gaps)
outcome: The Low findings from the clean 2A84 R2 review pair are fixed or explicitly declined with reasons.
acceptance: Gitlink endpoints that are not commits (for example tree OIDs) are reported as unreadable/wrong type, not Listed, with a real tree-OID fixture.
A renamed submodule's diff button keeps its 'from <original path>' detail in the accessible description, with a test.
The trailing-space and rename fixtures are independent of temp-root aliases and inherited status.renames configuration.
Internal status callers do not pay per-gitlink submodule detail reads, or the reads are bounded, and nested recursion stops once both groups are full.
Rust fixture tests cover the newly-added-gitlink ls-tree listing, the 100-path cap and remaining count, a nested incomplete/Unavailable result, and a nested SC.. pointer move.
A two-vendor review has no Medium or higher finding.
